headline: Trade lower cost and latency for persona consistency: {arm:f64} saves {cost.gap.f64.prod.per_1k} per 1,000 replies but drops {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points on character retention.
lede: Every candidate lowers cost and improves speed, but all regress on {aspects.persona.name}. The choice turns on whether persona losses in conversations past turn five justify the savings.

slots.text: {arm:f64} cuts reply cost from {cost_per_1k.prod|usd_per_1k} to {cost_per_1k.f64|usd_per_1k} and lowers latency, but drops {aspects.persona.name} by {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points.
{arm:prod} remains preferable if persona retention is worth more than {price.prod.f64.persona.per_point|usd} per percentage point gained; below that valuation, {arm:f64} is optimal.
Lean toward {arm:f64}: it preserves guardrails on {aspects.facts.name} and {aspects.specul.name} while cutting monthly spend by {cost.gap.f64.prod.monthly|usd_whole}.
A human evaluation of extended dialogue turns and user retention impact across long sessions would resolve whether degradation in later turns harms product trust.

method.text: {scoreboard.prod.ran} dialogue evaluations across {scoreboard.prod.cases} distinct conversation scenarios.
{judged.persona.label} was scored by a {judge.calibration} judge with agreement {judge.agreement} against {judged.persona.calibration_ratings} human labels.
Standing criteria require {criteria.facts.threshold} on {aspects.facts.name} and {criteria.specul.threshold} on {aspects.specul.name}.
Calculated using token counts evaluated at list price per 1,000 replies.
Monthly projections assume {meta.volume_per_month} replies per month.

flag.title: No decision rule set in advance
flag.text: Because acceptable loss on {aspects.persona.name} was not defined beforehand, stakeholders must weigh the unit savings against dialogue degradation.

sections.headline: All candidates show regressions on stays in character, while other measures remain largely stable.
sections.takeaway: Pairs display intervals across all measures, highlighting that only {aspects.persona.name} regresses significantly for {arm:f64}.
sections.caption: Contrasts report {family.level} intervals on paired differences without multi-candidate correction.

sections.headline: Persona drift accelerates in longer conversations across all models.
sections.takeaway: Consistency declines after turn five, where {arm:f64} falls from {strata.depth:1-2.f64.persona.mean} in early turns to {strata.depth:11+.f64.persona.mean} at depth 11+.

sections.headline: Persona losses concentrate heavily in banter and corrections.
sections.takeaway: Routine intros and recommendations drop minimally, but corrective interaction reveals significant character loss.

durable_claims.text: {arm:f64} reduces cost by {cost.gap.f64.prod.per_1k} per 1,000 replies while dropping {aspects.persona.name} by {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points ({contrast.f64.persona.interval|pts}).
Persona retention for {arm:f64} degrades from {strata.depth:1-2.f64.persona.mean} in turns 1–2 down to {strata.depth:11+.f64.persona.mean} in turns 11+.
